notes.title: Balancing Update
notes.content: Adjusted common Monster XP. It is harder to get to level 3 now by beating 2 common monsters.

notes.title: Updated attack balance and fixed minor bugs
notes.content: Updated units and heroes attack to climb slower. This makes enemies harder to hit especially at higher levels.

notes.title: Improve Starting fort selection
notes.content: Improved the selection of starting forts in procedural map games. Now it prioritizes being close to a monster.

notes.title: Various minor bugfixes
notes.content: Minor bugfixes and preparation for new UI layout.

notes.title: Minor Bug Fixes
notes.content:
- Fixed Swift Step bug that allowed double skill
- Fixed Fireball not creating aggro
- improved spawn location logic

Thanks to Minator for the reports!

notes.title: Fixed minor bugs and multiplayer sign up form
notes.content:
Minor bugs with cut-through, translations etc. have been fixed.

Also the signup and forgot password mechanics were fixed.

notes.title: Expansion Items
notes.content: Added the expansion items (some of them have placeholder art)

notes.title: Expansion factions added
notes.content:
Added Undead and Dwarves into the game as playable factions!

notes.title: Added new expansion hero skills
notes.content: Each hero got a 2 new advanced skills and one new basic skill. Expansion units, monsters and skills can be toggled on and off in the quick game settings.

notes.title: New Terrain Styling and Rejoinable lobbies
notes.content:
This update contains updates to how we display the terrain for more immersive gameplay.
It also allows players to rejoin lobbies when they quit games prematurely.

notes.title: Steamdeck Support
notes.content: When you select "Gamepad" as an input setting you can play the game seamlessly on steamdeck

notes.title: Small update
notes.content: Added logout functionality, fixed online change team bug for proxies and AI and improved on lobby logic

notes.title: Added the option to play local coop online
notes.content: Online games now support local couch coop on the same machine. Just add a "Proxy Player" and you can take turns on the same machine!

notes.title: Added reset passwords and player profiles
notes.content: Online players can now add their discord name to their profile and request resetting their password by email.

notes.title: Achievement Support
notes.content:
Finishing the tutorial and main campaigns will give you a steam achievement now.
You can also unlock Tournament Win and Kickstarter Backer achievements via code from the main menu.

notes.title: Improvements for gamepad support and saving and loading from file
notes.content: Improvements regarding gamepad support and saving and loading games from file.

notes.title: Gamepad support and various bugfixes and improvements
notes.content:
Added Gamepad support with a new "Gamepad" input option.

Also includes various other improvements and bugfixes.

notes.title: Various improvements
notes.content:
Make turn sequence in multiplayer random
Add Turn counter in map creator
Add Action Log and last action log elements to UI
Zoom out more by default
Zoom in and out with +/y and -/x keys for better laptop experience

notes.title: Setting for automatic camera movement
notes.content:
This patch contains a toggle for automatic camera movement restriction in the main menu settings.
It also contains various UI and translation improvements.

notes.title: Translation polishing and UI updates
notes.content:
- Polish Spanish and German translations
- Save selected locale between plays
- UI layout improvements
